posting.title: International Recruiter
posting.description:
International Recruiter — Commission-Based
Remote | Freelance \/ Flexible Arrangement
Company: Fab
Location: Remote
Compensation: US$450 for every 150 verified successful hires, equivalent to US$3 per qualifying hire, under the agreed commission terms.

About the opportunity
Fab is looking to hire international recruiters for a multinational client who can help identify and attract qualified candidates for remote Graduate Sales Executive positions and Marketers.

This opportunity is suitable for individuals with strong online research and candidate outreach skills.

You will help us connect suitable candidates with an international sales career opportunity while working remotely and managing your own sourcing activities.

Key responsibilities
Identify potential candidates in your assigned countries and professional communities.
Source applicants through LinkedIn, job boards, graduate networks, online communities and referrals.
Share accurate job descriptions and compensation information with prospective applicants.
Review CVs and LinkedIn profiles against agreed selection criteria.
Conduct initial screening and confirm English proficiency, interest and availability.
Explain the distinction between the part-time sales and full-time sales\/project management roles.
Submit complete, relevant candidate profiles through the designated recruitment process.
Coordinate interviews and follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
Maintain accurate records of candidate sources, applications, interviews and outcomes.
Protect candidate information and comply with applicable privacy requirements.

What we offer
A remote, flexible recruitment opportunity.
Commission-based earnings linked to qualifying successful hires.
The opportunity to source candidates across multiple international markets.
Clear job descriptions, candidate criteria and recruitment procedures.

Ideal Candidate
Experience in recruitment, talent sourcing, HR, sales or candidate outreach is an advantage.
Able to find and communicate with candidates through online platforms.
Strong written communication and organizational skills.
Comfortable screening CVs and assessing basic role suitability.
Reliable follow-up and accurate record keeping.
Professional approach to candidate privacy and honest representation of the opportunity.
Access to relevant professional, graduate or recruitment networks.
Previous recruitment experience is preferred but not essential if you can demonstrate effective sourcing and communication skills.

Commission structure
The proposed commission is US$450 for each completed block of 150 qualifying hires.
What we’re looking for
Experience in recruitment, talent sourcing, HR, sales or candidate outreach is an advantage.
Perks and benefits
Incentive Bonus

Location: Remote - Anywhere

Skills required for this job:

  • Candidate communication
  • Candidate screening
  • Data privacy
  • Online research
  • Record Maintenance
  • Recruitment
  • Talent sourcing

posting.title: Finance Clerk / Bookkeeping Assistant
posting.description:
Role: Part-Time Finance Clerk \/ Bookkeeping Assistant.
Company: Eastern Standard Consultants Inc. (DBA ESC Cabling).

Key Responsibilities:

Accounts Payable (AP):
- Receive, review, and enter vendor invoices into QuickBooks Online.
- Categorize expenses accurately, including project costs and cost of goods sold.
- Track outstanding bills and payment deadlines.
- Maintain vendor records and reconcile vendor statements.
- Prepare weekly accounts payable reports.
- Organize and maintain digital financial records.
- Prepare payments for management approval.

Accounts Receivable (AR):
- Prepare and send customer invoices.
- Generate progress billing and time-and-material invoices.
- Record customer payments in QuickBooks Online.
- Monitor outstanding customer balances.
- Follow up on overdue invoices.
- Maintain accurate accounts receivable records.
- Prepare weekly aging reports.

Bookkeeping:
- Maintain accurate financial transactions in QuickBooks Online.
- Assist with bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Review expense classifications.
- Identify missing transactions and discrepancies.
- Assist the external bookkeeper with monthly closing procedures.
- Maintain organized financial documentation.

Payroll Support:
- Review employee timesheets for completeness.
- Assist with payroll preparation.
- Maintain payroll documentation.
- Coordinate payroll information with management and the payroll processor.

Financial Reporting:
- Prepare weekly AP and AR summaries.
- Assist with monthly financial reports.
- Track outstanding invoices and upcoming payments.
- Provide financial updates to management.
- Identify discrepancies requiring management attention.

Qualifications:
- Minimum 2 years of bookkeeping or accounting support experience.
- Experience with QuickBooks Online.
- Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
- Strong organizational and communication skills.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality.
- Reliable computer and internet connection.
- Ability to work 20 hours weekly during New York business hours.
- Experience working with U.S.-based companies.
- Experience supporting construction or contracting businesses.
- Familiarity with job costing and project-based invoicing.
- Experience coordinating with external accountants or bookkeepers.

Location: Remote - GMT-06:00 to GMT-04:00

Skills required for this job:

  • Accounts payable
  • Accounts receivable
  • Bookkeeping
  • Construction accounting
  • Google Sheets
  • Invoicing
  • Job costing
  • Microsoft Excel
  • QuickBooks Online

posting.title: Travel Registered Nurse (RN) – Medical-Surgical
posting.description:
Travel Registered Nurse (RN) – Medical-Surgical | Day Shift

Location: Keene, New Hampshire
Pay: $66.57 per hour
Schedule: 7:00 AM – 7:30 PM | 12-hour day shifts
Hours: 36 hours per week
Start Date: December 7, 2026
Assignment Type: Temporary Travel Assignment

Position Overview

Proxena Health Group is recruiting an experienced Medical-Surgical Registered Nurse (RN) for a temporary travel assignment at a prominent medical center in Keene, New Hampshire.

This opportunity offers an attractive hourly rate, a consistent day-shift schedule, and the opportunity to provide care to an adult and geriatric patient population in a hospital setting.

Qualified travel nurses with strong Medical-Surgical experience and the ability to adapt to changing patient-care needs are encouraged to apply.

Compensation and Benefits

- $66.57 per hour
- 36 hours per week
- Estimated gross base pay of $2,396.52 per week, before applicable deductions
- Medical, dental, and vision insurance options
- Travel and housing stipends, where applicable
- 24\/7 dedicated recruiter support
- Licensure and certification reimbursement opportunities

Key Responsibilities

- Provide safe, high-quality nursing care to adult and geriatric patients.
- Assess, monitor, and document patients' conditions and responses to treatment.
- Administer medications and carry out prescribed nursing interventions.
- Collaborate with physicians and multidisciplinary healthcare teams.
- Monitor patient progress and communicate changes in clinical condition.
- Adapt to floating assignments as required by the facility.
- Maintain accurate and timely patient documentation using Epic.

Required Qualifications

- Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in New Hampshire or an eligible multistate compact license.
- Minimum of 2 years of Medical-Surgical nursing experience.
- Previous experience using the Epic electronic medical record system.
- Willingness and ability to float to other units as required.
- Current American Heart Association BLS certification.
- Current American Heart Association ACLS certification.
- Active NIH Stroke Scale (NIHSS) certification.

Assignment Details

Patient Population: Adult–Geriatric
Shift: Day shift, 7:00 AM – 7:30 PM
EMR: Epic
Start Date: December 7, 2026
Location: Keene, New Hampshire

## Apply Today

Interested and qualified Medical-Surgical Registered Nurses are encouraged to apply.

**Proxena Health Group LLC**
Connecting qualified healthcare professionals with rewarding opportunities.

Location: Keene, New Hampshire, United States

Skills required for this job:

  • Advanced cardiac life support (ACLS)
  • Basic life support (BLS)
  • Epic
  • Nursing techniques
  • Registered nurses
